describe: Two comparisons fixed before any held-out result is seen. (1) For SOXX and for QQQ: a linear ordinal model's risk gate against the frozen rule baseline, on the same held-out months, fills and costs. (2) For SOXX only: the same model with and without one factor that comes from the semiconductor research map, to isolate what that factor adds. The commit that adds this file is the proof of when the comparisons were fixed. On that date no model had been fitted to real prices and no outcome had been joined to real features; the runner had been exercised only on synthetic prices.
what_was_known_when_this_was_written: The frozen rule's result over all of 2009-09 to 2026-11 for both funds: it reduced maximum drawdown, ended with less than half of buy and hold's equity, and about two in three of its exits re-entered higher.
VIX/VIX3M and the VIX level against TSM minus SOXX around 289 TSMC revenue releases: nothing.
No fit of any model to SOXX or QQQ outcomes.
The coverage table beside this file, which reads features and whether each outcome window is complete, never an outcome's value.
That TSMC's first-released monthly figures from September 2003 agree with the values shown on its investor site today.

shared_setup.decision: Each US equity session at 17:00 America/New_York, basis exact; a value counts only if available strictly before it.
shared_setup.execution: A target decided after session t is traded at the open of session t+1.

accounting.note: As the frozen baseline. Prices exclude dividends.

shared_setup.inputs: Snapshot 2026-11-22: the frozen baseline's inputs plus tsmc_monthly_revenue_first_release.json, each pinned by hash below.

target.definition: Mean close of sessions t+1..t+20 over the open of session t+1, minus one (quant_evaluator.beta.forward_target).
target.classes: Four ordered classes with cut points r1 = -clip(0.8 * 0.6 * sigma_20 * sqrt(20), floor, cap), 0, -r1; sigma_20 is the sample standard deviation of the last 20 close-to-close returns through session t.

features_generic.note: the ratio itself, not a threshold
the subject's own close over its 200-session average, minus one

shared_setup.features_source: knowledge_base/prior_knowledge/bindings/factor_definitions.json: the factors the causal-map generator marks measurable for the subject with timing decision_time. A row with a missing feature is not trained on and gets no forecast.

walk_forward.refit: monthly, frozen before the month's first session
walk_forward.purge: a decision is trained on only if its target's last close is before the month's first session (21 sessions back)

gate.score: P_left = 1 - P(class >= 1), the probability of the left-tail class
gate.states: RED when P_left is at or above the trailing quantile for RED, YELLOW at or above the one for YELLOW, else GREEN. Quantiles are taken over the fund's own previous out-of-sample scores only.
gate.missing_forecast: the previous state is held and the session is counted, as in the frozen baseline

shared_setup.rule_arm: The frozen rule's targets from artifacts/ablations/sector_risk_baseline, restricted to the comparison period, with equity restarted at 1 on its first session.
shared_setup.metrics: As the frozen baseline: maximum drawdown, final equity, forward 20-session drawdown for stressed and ordinary decisions with a 90% interval from resampling whole episodes, whipsaw rate, re-entry cost, turnover, held sessions. Plus, per RFC-004: recall of gate alerts on the worst 15% of realised forward 20-session drawdowns, and the share of those windows labelled class 0.

end_dates.equity_and_drawdown: through the session of 2026-11-20, the last in the snapshot
end_dates.forward_recall_and_forward_drawdown: decisions through 2026-10-23, the last with a complete 20-session outcome

comparison_1_model_against_rule.primary: Maximum drawdown magnitude at base cost over the comparison period.
comparison_1_model_against_rule.promotion: The model's gate replaces the rule for a fund only if every limit under open_choices.promotion_limits holds. A tie or any failed limit keeps the rule. Higher-cost runs are reported as sensitivity and decide nothing.

comparison_2_graph_factor.why_soxx_only: The factor is a semiconductor demand reading. The prior makes no claim about it for QQQ.
arms: Model A gate on features_generic plus reported_revenue_growth_yoy

added_feature.reads: proxy: a company total standing in for sector demand
added_feature.values: Year-on-year change as each TSMC monthly release stated it on its issue date. A release that states a date and no time counts from noon UTC the next day.

comparison_2_graph_factor.everything_else: Identical in both arms: training dates, forecast dates, hold days, target, classes, model settings, folds, gate, exposure, costs, period.
comparison_2_graph_factor.reading: See open_choices.increment_rule. Whatever the outcome, one factor's result says nothing about the research map as a whole.
comparison_2_graph_factor.matched_samples: Both arms are fitted on the same training decisions and forecast the same decisions: those at which the revenue factor has a value. Where it has none, both arms have no forecast and both hold their previous state. The generic arm here is therefore a separate fit from comparison 1's, so that the arms differ in one feature and nothing else.
outcomes: completed, evidence threshold not met (a null result)
not completed: insufficient coverage (the test could not be run; this is not a null result)

settings_in_words.start_rule: No fixed dates. For each comparison and fund: a month is trained when at least min_train decisions have matured outcomes and complete features; the comparison starts on the first decision that has a forecast and at least 252 earlier out-of-sample scores, which is when the gate takes its first state. Days without a forecast count as held only after that. The dates this gives are read from coverage.json and written into the registration before any return is examined.
settings_in_words.exit_hysteresis: A state steps down only after 3 consecutive scored sessions below its threshold, and then to the highest level seen in those three. A session without a forecast holds the state and restarts the count.
settings_in_words.paired_inference: Cases are the worst 15% of realised forward 20-session drawdowns among decisions where both arms have a gate state. Two cases with fewer than 20 decisions between them belong to one episode (decisions 10 and 30 are one episode, 10 and 31 are two); this is the same count the frozen rule baseline's episodes use. Each of 2000 draws (seed 20261122) resamples these episodes with replacement and computes both arms' recall on that same draw (quant_evaluator.beta.model_gate.paired_recall_difference). Episodes come from outcomes, not from either arm's alerts.
settings_in_words.revenue_data: Use the first-released value only once its availability time precedes the decision. Measure its 45-day age from the reporting month's end (23:59:59 Asia/Taipei). An isolated missing release falls under the shared hold rule.

promotion_limits.drawdown: the model's maximum drawdown magnitude is smaller than the rule's by at least 2 percentage points
promotion_limits.return_sacrifice: the model's final equity is at least 95% of the rule's over the comparison period
promotion_limits.whipsaw: the model's whipsaw rate is no more than 5 points above the rule's

increment_rule.useful_evidence: With the factor, recall on the worst 15% of forward drawdowns is higher by at least 5 points while the share of sessions in RED or YELLOW is higher by no more than 2 points, AND the 90% interval for the paired difference in recall lies above zero, AND maximum drawdown is not larger.
increment_rule.null: Anything else, including a better point estimate whose interval includes zero.

settings_in_words.sufficient_coverage: Comparison 2 counts as completed only if, over the decisions defined under denominators, there are at least 3000, the held ones are no more than 1% of them, and they contain at least 15 realised drawdown episodes. The first two were read from the coverage table; the third is fixed here and counted when the comparison is run.
settings_in_words.sensitivities: Reported and deciding nothing: costs at 2 and 3 times the base rate, a 5-year rolling training window, a 5-session embargo, and a left-tail loss weight of 1.5.
settings_in_words.accepted: The owner accepted these settings on 2026-11-22.
settings_in_words.denominators: Everything in comparison 2's evidence rule and coverage conditions is counted over one set of decisions: those from the comparison's first decision that have a complete 20-session outcome and a gate state in both arms. Recall, its paired difference, the share of sessions in RED or YELLOW, the count of gate days and the count of held days all use that set.
settings_in_words.turnover: Turnover counts only target changes that can be executed, up to the decision before the last session, as the equity curve does.

reporting_period_calendar.basis_note: One session per calendar month, dated on its last day. A reporting period, not a trading calendar.

inputs.retrieval: As the frozen baseline: VIX.csv, VIX3M.csv, SOXX.json and QQQ.json are downloaded market data kept on the machine that ran it; the other files are in the repository.

coverage.note: coverage.py and coverage.json beside this file are part of the registration commit, so the start dates can be reproduced from another checkout.

known_limits: About 45 independent stress episodes per fund over the whole sample, fewer in the comparison period. That is the sample size for any difference between two gates.
The gate thresholds, class bounds and feature definitions come from RFC-002 and RFC-004, which were written knowing this period.
The rule's full-period results were known when this was drafted, so the promotion limits were set with that knowledge.
Cboe, Yahoo and Treasury publication times are assumptions. Prices exclude dividends.
The revenue factor changes once a month while outcomes span 20 sessions; a real effect would have to be large to show.
The first-release revenue values were read through a page reader that returns quoted fragments; the numbers were cross-checked, the wording was not.
Model A's penalty of 10 and the 750-decision minimum are judgements made without tuning; RFC-004 gives neither.

code.smoke_test: run.py --synthetic SEED replaces both funds' prices with a seeded random walk and writes to output_synthetic/. It was run with seed 1 before registration to exercise the code; its numbers mean nothing about the funds.
code.enforcement: A run on real prices requires this file to be committed and unchanged, run.py to equal its version at code.commit, and imports the packages from an export of that commit. A --synthetic rehearsal uses local code.
